architecture.name: RAVEL-6144-v1
architecture.feature_dependency: decoded reconstruction and fixed role metadata only
architecture.flatten_order: right_edge fastest, then left_edge, amplitude, row_rms_class, role
architecture.sharing_scope: one table shared by all roles and all six panel experts

feature_semantics.row_class: count of strict comparisons log2(row_scale/matrix_scale) > (-0.25, 0.0, 0.25); equality remains in the lower class
feature_semantics.amplitude: floor((decoded/row_scale + 4)*4), clipped to integer [0,31]; lower edges inclusive and upper edges exclusive before saturation
feature_semantics.boundary: noncyclic self-clamp: missing left/right neighbor equals the center coordinate
feature_semantics.edge_state: 2*(neighbor >= 0) + 1*(abs(neighbor) > abs(center)); zero is nonnegative and magnitude ties are false

projection.entry: numerator/denominator, with exact zero for an empty cell
required_checks: oracle SSE no greater than zero-correction holdout SSE within declared numerical tolerance
oracle SSE no greater than emitted fit-table SSE within declared numerical tolerance

packet.header_encoding: canonical ASCII JSON plus LF then zero padding

rate_and_read.amortization_contract: exactly one shared 16384-byte table over the six-panel denominator; any table multiplicity change requires a new ledger

decision.kill: numerical source-leaking favorable oracle F > 0.8 after dominance checks
decision.survive: permission only for controls and a finite reduced-coarse-rate re-encode

input_authentication: reject link/reparse components; open regular files with no-follow; authenticate and parse the same immutable byte snapshot; compare identity before/open/after
output_protocol: reserve absent output directory before payload access; stage files; atomically publish members; write COMPLETE.json last; incomplete directories are invalid
claim_boundary: Frozen decoded nonlinear one-table RAVEL-6144-v1 cell only; source-leaking favorable bound is neither a finite reduced-rate codec nor a universal residual-code converse.
